details:
We got group ownership transfer. That's a good start. It doesn't cover one scenario however.

The current group owner has to be alive and able to use a computer to be able to transfer ownership.

So in a scenario where the original group owner unexpectedly passes away or otherwise looses their ability to manage the group, there doesn't seem to be any way for another group member to take over all responsibilities.

Having experienced cases of friends passing and the communities they built going along with them, I was looking for ways to ensure that won't happen with my groups.

For now, I created another role which has all permissions and gave that to people who I believe to be capable to take over. However, I have to update this role every time VRChat introduces NEW permissions.

In case I'm no longer able to do this, I'd like a way to ensure that somebody else in my group always retains the same full set of permissions, just like the group owner.

Maybe the "Manage Group Roles" permission already does that, but it's not clear to me whether it would allow anyone to manage the permissions of their own role.

I have no specific solution to this in mind. I can think of a few options:

- Group Co-Ownership

- "Full permissions" checkbox for roles which always includes all current and future permissions instead of selecting them individually

Maybe there are even better options which I didn't think of.
title: Digital Legacy and Group Permissions
